findings.text: The `command:<name>` event used to be emitted on the command itself after its action handler ran. It is now emitted only on `this.parent`, and only when a parent exists. A listener such as `program.on('command:build', ...)` on a root command with an action handler used to fire and now never does, and a listener on the command itself never fires either. Any listener attached to the emitting command silently stops being called.
